title: Dynamic Subspace-Rotation Triggers for Intraday Factor Estimation
about: Fade lagged idiosyncratic cross-asset futures OFI; trigger PCA refits on factor-subspace rotation.
findings: Author claims positive net returns and roughly doubled risk-adjusted performance in the weaker subperiod; explicitly not formal OOS. Not reproduced.
mechanism: Temporary idiosyncratic order pressure and institutional reallocation can change common flow factors; interpretation unverified.
build_on: Owned NQ minute aggregates do not supply the simultaneous20-market L1tick panel or2018–22design history. Bounded public TickBroker/data search located no matching free panel; parked, no minute-price/volume proxy.
code_feasibility: Potentially after full source and matching tick OFI data, exact rotation/refit/entry/fill/cost settings and frozen training clocks. No implementation admitted.
